spec.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player (Left)
spec.genInstructions: Build the left-hand deck: a large jog wheel with transport (play/pause, cue), pitch/tempo fader, sync, hot cue pads, loop controls, and track/BPM/time readouts so the DJ can play, scratch, cue and beat-manipulate the track loaded on channel A.
spec.role: The left performance deck that plays and manipulates one track, feeding its audio and playback state to the mixer and waveform while receiving loads from the library and seeks from the waveform.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Track Library Browser (Bottom)
effectors.description: When the user loads a track to Deck A (double-click or 'Load to Deck A'), the file, title, artist, BPM, key and duration are pushed into Deck A, which resets the transport to the first cue point and enables playback.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display (Top)
effectors.description: When the user clicks or drags on Deck A's waveform lane, the target playback position is sent to Deck A, which seeks its playhead to that position.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
effectors.description: When an FX unit is assigned to Deck A and toggled on, the rack processes Deck A's audio (filter/delay/reverb) applying the selected effect, wet/dry amount and beat-synced timing to Deck A's output.

targets.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display (Top)
targets.description: Deck A streams its loaded track's full waveform data plus continuous playhead position, tempo and cue markers so the top waveform lane renders and scrolls in real time as Deck A plays, scratches or is pitch-adjusted.

targets.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer
targets.description: Deck A routes its audio signal into mixer channel A and sends its current BPM/level so the channel strip meters, EQ and volume fader act on Deck A's output.

targets.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
targets.description: Deck A sends its current BPM to the FX rack so beat-synced effects (echo, beat multipliers) time their intervals to Deck A's tempo.

library.description: Rotary control; vertical drag maps to a value within min..max, optionally snapping to a provided list of step values. Value is in the caller's own units.
Linear travel control, vertical or horizontal; handle position maps linearly to a value within min..max, optionally snapping to detent values.
Momentary button; fires onPress on press (and optional onRelease) without holding state. Face content supplied by the caller.
Latching on/off button; clicking flips the boolean state and emits it. Face content supplied by the caller.
Performance pad representing one cue slot; press triggers the cue (onPress), with state showing whether the slot is empty, set, or currently active.

Large circular platter; dragging rotates it and emits angular delta in revolutions (positive = forward), with touch state for scratch vs pitch-bend; rotation reflects the supplied playback angle in revolutions.
Read-only alphanumeric readout showing a string or number value supplied by the caller (track title, artist/BPM, elapsed/remaining time); content and units are the caller's.
Segmented audio level meter; level is normalized 0-1, optional peak hold also normalized 0-1.
Small state lamp showing a discrete status (e.g. idle/loading/loaded/error) with optional blink.
Inline set of mutually exclusive options; selecting one emits its id. Used for 2-position switches and multi-option pickers alike.

Scrolling waveform strip for one track: renders normalized 0-1 amplitude samples, a playhead at a position in seconds, beat grid lines in seconds, and cue markers in seconds; clicking or dragging emits the target position in seconds. Zoom is seconds of track visible across the lane.

props.cues?: { id: string; time: number; label?: string }[]

library.description: Read-only ruler marking elapsed time across a horizontal span, from start to start+span seconds.
Read-only linear progress indication; value and max share the caller's unit (e.g. seconds).
Single-line text input for filtering; emits its current text on every change and onSubmit on enter.
Hierarchical list of nested nodes (playlists/folders); selecting a node emits its id, expanding/collapsing emits the node id and state.

props.nodes: { id: string; label: string; children?: any[] }[]

library.description: Sortable multi-column list of track rows; selecting a row emits its id, activating (double-click) emits it too, and clicking a column header emits the column key and sort direction.

props.columns: { key: string; label: string; sortable?: boolean }[]

spec.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer
spec.genInstructions: Build the central mixer with two channel strips (gain/trim, 3-band EQ, filter, volume fader, level meter) for channels A and B, plus a crossfader, master volume and headphone cue, so the DJ can blend, EQ and balance the two decks into the master output.
spec.role: The central blending hub that receives both decks' audio and mixes them via channel strips and crossfader into the master output, serving as the terminal audio sink of the table.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player (Left)
effectors.description: Deck A feeds its audio signal and BPM/level into channel A; the channel A meter, EQ, filter and volume fader operate on this incoming Deck A signal.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player (Right)
effectors.description: Deck B feeds its audio signal and BPM/level into channel B; the channel B meter, EQ, filter and volume fader operate on this incoming Deck B signal.

spec.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player (Right)
spec.genInstructions: Build the right-hand deck mirroring Deck A: large jog wheel with transport (play/pause, cue), pitch/tempo fader, sync, hot cue pads, loop controls and track/BPM/time readouts so the DJ can play, scratch, cue and beat-manipulate the track loaded on channel B.
spec.role: The right performance deck that plays and manipulates a second track, feeding its audio and playback state to the mixer and waveform while receiving loads from the library and seeks from the waveform.
